text: Up here! Forty years a pilot in this harbour, and now this.
Steady... steady as she goes. Without me.
Take this. A drowned man's wages, he won't need them.
Here. Money from the harbour office. Nobody will miss it now.
A gun. Well. I have steered worse things through worse water.
Thank you. Keep your head down, I will keep mine.
Then I come as I am. I know every stair in this pen.
They wanted me to take the cargo ship out, at night, no lights. I said no. So they put me up here with the lamp.
Ahoy! Up the tower! The signal tower, here!
Hello down there! Up the stairs, I am in the tower!
